title: Điền câu vào đoạn văn (1)
intro: Đề tốt nghiệp câu 18–22: chọn câu/cụm từ điền vào đoạn văn. Mẹo: xem câu trước và sau chỗ trống; kiểm tra ngữ pháp (mệnh đề quan hệ, rút gọn mệnh đề, chủ ngữ) và ý có liên kết không.
instruction: Chọn phương án phù hợp nhất cho mỗi chỗ trống.

items.title: Smart cities
items.passage: A smart city is a city (1) ___. For example, sensors on the streets can measure traffic and air quality, and traffic lights can change automatically to reduce congestion. (2) ___, residents can pay bills, book doctor appointments and report problems online. Many experts believe smart cities will help save energy, (3) ___. However, building a smart city is expensive, and (4) ___. Some people also worry about privacy, because smart systems collect a large amount of personal data. Therefore, governments need clear rules (5) ___.

options: that uses technology to improve the quality of life
which technology improves the quality of life
uses technology to improve the quality of life
where improving the quality of life with technology
items.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ đầy đủ bổ nghĩa cho a city: that uses technology… Các phương án khác sai cấu trúc.

options: Thanks to mobile apps
Although mobile apps
Mobile apps are used
Because mobile apps are
items.explain: Cụm trạng ngữ "Thanks to + danh từ," đứng trước mệnh đề chính.

options: cut pollution and make transport more efficient
cutting pollution and make transport more efficient
to cut pollution and made transport more efficient
cut pollution and making transport efficiently
items.explain: Song song với save energy (sau will help): cut … and make …

options: not every city can afford the technology
the technology every city can afford
every city affording the technology
which not every city can afford
items.explain: Sau "and" cần một mệnh đề đầy đủ: not every city can afford the technology.

options: to protect people's information
protecting people's information is
that people's information protects
people's information protected
items.explain: rules + to V (mục đích): rules to protect…

items.title: Work experience
items.passage: More and more Vietnamese students are doing work experience before they finish school. (6) ___, students can find out whether a job really suits them. A student who wants to become a nurse, for example, can spend a week in a hospital (7) ___. Work experience also helps students develop soft skills such as teamwork and communication, (8) ___. In addition, it looks good on a CV. (9) ___, students should choose a placement carefully and prepare questions to ask. Teachers say that the students (10) ___ are usually those who are curious and willing to learn.

options: By spending time in a real workplace
They spend time in a real workplace
Spent time in a real workplace
Although spending time in a real workplace
items.explain: By + V-ing (bằng cách) làm trạng ngữ cho mệnh đề chính.

options: to see what nurses do every day
seeing what do nurses every day
which nurses do every day
for seeing nurses do what every day
items.explain: to V chỉ mục đích; câu hỏi gián tiếp giữ trật tự chủ ngữ + động từ: what nurses do.

options: which are important in any job
that is important in any job they
important in any job are
which they are important in any job
items.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định bổ nghĩa cho soft skills: which are…

options: To get the most out of it
Getting the most out of it is
They get the most out of it
Because getting the most out of it
items.explain: To V chỉ mục đích đứng đầu câu: To get the most out of it, students should…

options: who benefit the most
who they benefit the most
benefit the most
which benefit the most
items.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ người: the students who benefit the most.
